de-doe-2026-sl-primary-results.note: The file behind the Department's results page; every row says OFFICIAL RESULTS, report time 2026-09-16T14:35:00, all election districts reported. de-doe-2026-local-general-list.title: Filed Candidates by Office, General Election 11/3/2026: county offices (Excel)
de-doe-2026-local-general-list.note: The county rows of the list's own Excel file (128 filings: 95 state, 5 federal, 28 county). Six columns are read, by their headings: county, office, withdrawal date, ballot name, party and status. The name parts, filing date, residential and mailing addresses, website, e-mail addresses and telephone numbers in the file are never read, and only the six kept cells of the county rows are kept on disk; the fingerprint is of the workbook as it was fetched. Of the 28 county rows, 27 are candidates printed on the ballot, each stored in one contest, and 1 withdrew and is left off. Provisional: 0. The list gives no ballot positions. Read a second way, from the list's own page, the county rows come to the same counts by office, county, party and status, and the page has as many rows as the file.

The same columns are read, less party (the list gives none); the contact columns are never read. The fingerprint is of the workbook as it was fetched. Read a second way, from the list's own page, the county rows come to the same counts by office, county and status, and the page has as many rows as the file.

Only the cells under the headings Office, County, Party and Status are read; the Candidate cell, which carries the name with contact details, and the Filed cell are never read, and the page is not kept. The fingerprint is of the page as it was fetched.

de-doe-2026-municipal-calendar.note: Only the election dates are read: 49 dated entries, from January 3, 2026 to December 5, 2026, none of them on November 3, 2026. The towns' names and websites on the calendar are not kept.

de-doe-2026-general-election-page.note: Read only for whether the general election's sample ballots, which would give the ballot order, are posted: on the day it was read the page said they were not yet available. Nothing else of the page is kept.

local_calendar.t: On November 3, 2026 each of Delaware's three counties elects a sheriff and a recorder of deeds, New Castle and Sussex counties elect a register of wills, and part of each county's governing body is chosen: New Castle County Council districts 1 to 6, the Kent County Levy Court's at-large seat and districts 2, 4 and 6, and Sussex County Council districts 4 and 5; all are partisan offices. The other county offices and council seats, and the City of Wilmington's mayor, treasurer and council, are elected with the President, next in 2028. School board members are elected every year on the second Tuesday in May (May 12 in 2026), and the other cities and towns hold their own elections on dates set by their charters, none of them on November 3 this year.
local_calendar.s: Delaware Department of Elections, Schedule of Elections: Elected Office Table 2026-2034, and 2026 Municipal Elections Calendar; 14 Del. C. section 1072(c) (school board elections)

local_coverage.t: Loaded from the Department of Elections' lists of filed candidates and of declared write-in candidates for the November 3, 2026 general election, as read on September 30, 2026: all 20 county contests on the Department's schedule for 2026 (9 in New Castle County, 6 in Kent County and 5 in Sussex County), with 27 candidates printed on the ballot and 1 declared write-in candidate; 1 candidate who withdrew is left off. The lists give no ballot positions, so no ballot order is shown. Not loaded: the September 15 party primaries for county offices, ballot questions (a list of candidates carries none), and anything about a candidate beyond the name as filed, the office, the party and the status. No city, town, school board or special district office is on Delaware's November 3 ballot: the Department's schedule, calendars and lists have none for that day.
local_coverage.s: Delaware Department of Elections, Filed Candidates by Office and Write-In Candidates by Office, General Election 11/3/2026
